svg.title: Workshop the Pattern
svg.desc: Sketch: two mannequin readers stand at a table with a hatched pattern card on it; one points at the card approvingly, and the other holds a pencil over it to suggest a change. The author stands apart with a hand cupped to one ear. The table and card are a pattern workshop: a new pattern set out for others to read before it leaves draft, and the card is the focus. The two readers are the solution's "at least two readers besides its author". The pointing reader is saying what works, which comes first; the reader with the pencil is saying what could be better, which comes second. The author standing apart and listening is the rule that the author listens first and asks questions only at the end. The metaphor: a pattern as a piece of craft set on a bench for others to inspect, with its maker stepping back.
